governing_identity.saturated_plateau: h=0, K=KSAT, dh/dz=0 therefore q=KSAT exactly
governing_identity.unsaturated_endpoint_path_cm: L_u(h_top) = integral_{0}^{h_top} Kr(h)/(Kr(h)-1) dh at q=KSAT
governing_identity.vgm_near_saturation_asymptotic: 1-Kr ~ 2*(alpha*abs(h))^(n-1) as h -> 0-; therefore the q=KSAT endpoint path is locally integrable iff 1<n<2
governing_identity.q_gt_ksat_monotonicity: For fixed h_surface=0 and h_top<0, dL/dq < 0 on every regular q>KSAT branch because the pointwise derivative of K/(K-q) with respect to q is positive while integration proceeds from 0 to negative h_top. Thus if lim_{q->KSAT+} L(q) < face length, no regular q>KSAT pure-unsaturated root can satisfy the full face length.

endpoint_plateau_admissible_if: h_surface is exactly 0 within the frozen boundary-state semantics
1 < n < 2 so the endpoint path is finite
two independently implemented endpoint integrals agree within the frozen endpoint tolerance
plateau_length = face_length - L_u is finite and nonnegative
Darcy residual on the plateau is exactly zero under q=K*(1-dh/dz)
head is continuous at the plateau-to-unsaturated join h=0
the unsaturated-side dh/dz tends to 0 as h -> 0-
no water amount, constitutive parameter or physical state is altered to create the plateau
policy_to_test.endpoint_exact_if: L_u equals face_length within endpoint_class_tolerance; q=KSAT and plateau_length=0
policy_to_test.interior_root_if: L_u > face_length + endpoint_class_tolerance or the endpoint integral diverges
policy_to_test.positive_surface_head: excluded from endpoint plateau admission; h_surface>0 requires the ordinary interior q>KSAT branch because the saturated head drop has finite positive length only for q>KSAT
policy_to_test.failure_policy: Any failed eligibility, nonfinite value, oracle disagreement or unsupported constitutive regime fails closed to the qualified reference/FullRichards route. Never clip, merge, smooth or change water to force endpoint admission.

acceptance.unsaturated_gradient_limit_check: abs(1-1/Kr(h)) strictly decreases toward zero over h=-1e-2,-1e-4,-1e-8,-1e-12 cm in high precision for admitted witnesses

architecture_binding.persistent_state: none; plateau length is derived face-local geometry, not committed column state
architecture_binding.transaction_semantics: candidate endpoint diagnostics are trial-local; rejected trials cannot alter committed state
architecture_binding.solver_policy: endpoint admissibility is numerical/face policy and does not modify physical hydraulic parameters
architecture_binding.fallback: fail closed to reference/FullRichards where eligibility is not proven

theory_sources.use: steady-state Darcy integration; saturated regions handled in head space and analytically along uniform paths

theory_sources.citation: Schaap and van Genuchten 2006, Vadose Zone Journal, DOI 10.2136/vzj2005.0005
theory_sources.use: sharp VGM conductivity behavior immediately below saturation, especially low n
